chunks: 1849 - And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام used to supplicate with this supplication in the month of Ramadan.

"O Allah, this is the month of Ramadan in which You sent down the Qur'an. This is the month of sawm (fasting), this is the month of turning back, this is the month of tawbah (repentance), this is the month of forgiveness and mercy, and this is the month of freedom from the Fire and triumph with Paradise. O Allah, deliver it safely to me and receive it from me, help me in it with the best of Your help, grant me success in it for Your obedience, free me in it for Your worship, Your supplication, and the recitation of Your Book, magnify for me in it the blessing, make well-being good for me in it, make my body sound for me in it, expand in it my provision, suffice me in it regarding what concerns me, answer in it my supplication, and let me attain in it my hope. O Allah, remove from me in it drowsiness, laziness, weariness, slackness, hardness, heedlessness, and delusion. O Allah, keep me away in it from ailments, sicknesses, anxieties, sorrows, afflictions, diseases, mistakes, and sins, and turn away from me in it evil, indecency, hardship, affliction, fatigue, and suffering."
"Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."

O Allah, grant me refuge in it from the accursed Shaytan, his goading, his slander, his blowing, his puffing, his whispering, his plotting, his scheming, his deception, his false wishes, his trickery, his delusion, his temptation, his cavalry, his infantry, his partners, his factions, his helpers, his followers, his intimates, his partisans, his allies, and all of their plotting. O Allah, grant me in it the completion of its fasting, attainment of hope in its standing, and completion of what pleases You from me in patience, faith, certainty, and seeking reward; then accept that from me with many multiplied measures and great reward. O Allah, grant me in it earnestness, striving, strength, vigor, turning back, repentance, desire, fear, anguish, humility, tenderness, truthful speech, fear from You, hope in You, reliance upon You, trust in You, and scrupulousness regarding Your sacred limits, along with righteous speech and accepted striving.

[And the completion of what pleases You from me in it in patience, certainty, faith, and seeking reward; then accept that from me with many multiplied measures and great reward. O Allah, grant me in it earnestness, striving, strength, vigor, turning back, repentance, desire, fear, anguish, humility, tenderness, truthful speech, fear from You, hope in You, reliance upon You, trust in You, and scrupulousness regarding Your sacred limits, along with righteous speech and accepted striving; and the completion of what pleases You from me in it in patience, certainty, faith, and seeking reward; then accept that from me with many multiplied measures and great reward. O Allah, grant me in it earnestness, striving, strength, vigor, turning back, repentance, desire, fear, anguish, and tenderness.]
And elevated deed and answered supplication, and do not place between me and any of that any affliction, nor illness, nor worry, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَةِ: Allah's mercy hoped for in Ramadan.
key_terms.الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ: The accursed Shaytan from whom refuge is sought.
key_terms.النَّارِ: The Fire, from which freedom is sought.
key_terms.الْقُرْآنَ: The divine Book revealed in this month.
key_terms.الْمَغْفِرَةِ: Divine forgiveness sought in the supplication.
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The blessed month of fasting and devotion.

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام recite in the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This supplication from Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام presents Ramadan as the month of the Qur'an, sawm (fasting), tawbah (repentance), mercy, and salvation from the Fire. It asks Allah for spiritual focus, physical well-being, protection from sin and Shaytan, acceptance of worship, and success in completing the acts of devotion that bring divine pleasure.
